_doc: Auditable peer set for the spear's EV/oz comp (Phase 5 of docs/VALIDATION_FLYWHEEL_PLAN.md). The engine's live comp still reads v5_config.json -> dynamic_discovery_v5 (peer_comp_tickers + peer_registry); this file is the INSPECTION layer: explicit inclusion criteria, per-peer provenance, and the exclusion log — so membership is reproducible, never a black box. Keep the two in sync when peers change; the data-integrity auditor flags drift.

inclusion_criteria.stage_window: delineation through DFS — normalizable to the target's pre-PEA frame via the Lassonde stage curve (peer_normalization.py); producers excluded (different capital structure)
inclusion_criteria.jurisdiction: Tier-1/Tier-2 mining jurisdictions (US/Canada/stable LatAm); jurisdiction_risk discount applied per peer
inclusion_criteria.size: resource large enough to be a credible analogue (>= ~50M oz AgEq) and listed with a readable EV
inclusion_criteria.vehicle: single-asset or near-single-asset junior (the comp prices ounces-in-ground, not a portfolio)

outlier_policy: median + MAD modified-z > 3.5 -> flagged and down-weighted to 0.25x, never silently dropped (peer_normalization.blended_peer_ev_oz; active at n>=4 peers)
regime_guardrail: V4 stands: the multiple is NEVER regime-conditioned — the archetype layer already applies the regime once, on the tilt leg (docs/BACKLOG_ASSESSMENT_2026-06-10.md)

peers.name: Blackrock Silver
peers.why_included: Tonopah West — the parcel adjacent to AGA.V/Hughes and their sole focus; the prime comp, pinned to full relevance weight
peers.resource_basis: research_cache (~21.1M M&I / 86.9M inferred AgEq); registry oz is a stale fallback only

peers.name: Southern Silver Exploration
peers.why_included: large AgEq resource at PFS — stage-normalized down to the pre-PEA frame

peers.name: AbraSilver Resource
peers.why_included: large AgEq resource at DFS; higher jurisdiction_risk discount applied

excluded.reason: DELISTED — kept in the registry under _DV.V_DELISTED as a tombstone; excluded from the live comp
